description: Performance sweep - Ruby: valkey-glide-ruby vs redis-rb (high-throughput configs, 10s command timeout). Select the GLIDE gem with bench-aws.sh --ruby-client-version (default 1.0.0); redis-rb is the stable yardstick, so compare GLIDE/redis-rb ratios across runs to cancel instance-to-instance noise. Connections stop at 16: the Ruby engine's default process mode forks one worker per connection and caps at 16.
